entities.name: Céleste Bulkeley
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Céleste Bulkeley was a French aristocrat and soldier in the Catholic and Royal Army during the war in the Vendée. She was one of at least six women in the army of François de Charette known as the "amazons". She was particularly known in the 19th century, being included as a heroine in many school books of the time.
